ACS Energy Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in showing that finite trajectory length, cell size, and sampling can produce apparently reliable but inaccurate ionic diffusivities in solid electrolytes, hidden behind linear MSDs and Arrhenius behavior. Significance: the α(t) diagnostic quantitatively links dynamical convergence to finite-time bias, enabling accuracy-based analysis-time selection, better material ranking, and more efficient computational screening.

💡 This review uniquely consolidates phosphorus-doped compounds as multifunctional mediators in lithium–sulfur batteries, integrating shuttle suppression, accelerated redox kinetics, enhanced conductivity, and dendrite inhibition across cathodes and separators.
